concept: Kinesis Data Streams: real-time ingest, multiple consumers, replay
tests: Choosing a service to ingest hundreds of thousands of events per second with multiple independent consumers and the ability to re-read.
expected: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams — high throughput, multiple independent consumers, records retained for replay. Triggers: "clickstream", "hundreds of thousands events per second", "multiple consumers", "replay".
why_not: SQS — a message is read by one consumer and deleted, no replay; SNS — fan-out without retention/replay; Batch — batch compute.
